statement.notes: 1) Revenue mapped to 'Sales and other operating revenue' line. 'Income from equity affiliates' and 'Other income' are not included in revenue as they are separate line items in 'Total revenues and other income'. 2) For 'total_operating_cost', all items under 'Costs and other deductions' are listed as separate array elements, following the rule not to sum them. This includes: Crude oil and product purchases, Production and manufacturing expenses, Selling, general and administrative expenses, Depreciation and depletion, Exploration expenses, Non-service pension and postretirement benefit expense, and Other taxes and duties. Interest expense is excluded as it is a separate field. 3) 'Net income' mapped to 'Net income (loss) attributable to ExxonMobil'. 4) 'Taxes' mapped to 'Income tax expense (benefit)'. 5) 'Interest_expenses' mapped directly. 6) All values are in millions of dollars as per the statement. 7) Supplementary tables provide detailed breakdowns (e.g., components of Other taxes and duties, Income tax expense, Depreciation and depletion) but were not used to create additional array elements per the instruction to not add numbers up.
